phases.objective: Build the residual canonical fixed-point layer on top of the branch-generic server-policy, semantic-verifier and test-authority lifecycle already present on current main: validate the complete tracked executable universe with hardcoded safe validators, require explicit invariant protection, and bind Policy Objection CI plus Derived State Closure to exact-candidate fixed-point evidence.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The exact merge candidate cannot satisfy canonical governance evidence unless semantic verifier projection matches registered authorities, tracked executables pass hardcoded validators or a fingerprint-bound governed exclusion, discovered tests remain registered, each invariant retains test and verifier authority, and the same fixed-point result is consumed by Policy Objection CI and Derived State Closure.
steps: Load the canonical semantic verifier requirements from main and the fixed-point compatibility projection.
Build the repository semantic report on the exact GitHub merge candidate.
Validate JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Bash, PowerShell and SQL through hardcoded validators without executing repository-supplied commands.
Keep historical non-executable placeholders only through exact-path governed exclusions bound to the current Git blob fingerprint and an existing canonical replacement.
Discover tracked tests and require both the canonical invariant authority registry and the fixed-point registry to retain protecting tests and verifier authorities.
Attach fixed-point convergence to canonical Policy Objection producer evidence and require that evidence in Derived State Closure.
assertions: No new Workflow authority is added.
Registry data cannot provide arbitrary shell commands or arbitrary command-line arguments.
Tracked executables minus successfully validated executables minus fingerprint-bound governed exclusions is empty.
A governed executable exclusion becomes blocking when its blob fingerprint changes or its declared canonical replacement disappears.
PowerShell parser validation transports the repository path through a process environment binding rather than interpolating repository data into the PowerShell command string.
Discovered tests minus registered tests minus governed exclusions is empty.
The fixed-point test is registered in the canonical invariant_authorities consumed by the base closure as well as the fixed-point invariant registry.
Removing the last test protecting a registered invariant fails closed.
Policy Objection CI and Derived State Closure consume the same exact-candidate fixed-point contract.
No live Ruleset Apply, Production deployment, database/provider mutation, credential payload access, force push, or protected-ref mutation is performed by this PR.
